description: Create a temporary 24-hour Soundiiz import link for 1 to 200 supplied or assistant-selected tracks. Optional sourceName credits the actual curator; do not claim user-supplied songs as your own selection. Optional sourceLogo is an existing HTTPS illustration URL for the Soundiiz import page, not a cover uploaded to the destination. Do not invent a credit or image URL. Show the exact returned shareUrl, including query parameters, and expiry. Preserve a requested destination and omit it otherwise. The user reviews the tracks and completes the transfer in Soundiiz. Omit unknown album or ISRC metadata. No music-service password or token is needed.

destination.description: Include only when the user requests a platform. Use the public slug returned by listSoundiizImportDestinations, such as apple-music or youtube-music. Existing Soundiiz corenames, such as applemusicapp or ytmusic, are also accepted. Otherwise omit this field.

sourceLogo.description: Optional existing HTTPS illustration URL for the large image on the Soundiiz import page. It is not the small platform icon or a cover sent to the destination. No upload or hosting is performed. Omit when no usable image URL is available; do not send base64, data URLs, local paths, or chat attachment references.

sourceName.description: Optional single-line credit for the actual curator or assistant that selected the songs, in the user's language. Omit when unknown to retain the default Soundiiz source name. A supplied tracklist does not imply that the assistant selected it.

artists.description: Artist names as an array; use an empty array when unknown.

name: createSoundiizImportLink

expiresAt.description: Import expiry as a Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC).

httpStatus.description: HTTP status associated with this tool error.

retryAfter.description: Wait at least this many seconds before retrying.

title: Create a Soundiiz playlist import link
